key: Fuel left is calculated from the average consumption reported by the motorcycle CCU (more accurate than the default value), and decreases gradually according to the consumption at that moment. Pick the byte in the CCU data packet (id 1) that holds the average consumption: see Raw CCU data below and compare it with the average fuel figure on the dash. key: The dash asks the app for its language through the CCU. The code sent follows the language chosen in Settings > Appearance (see Translations.tsv, row @dashLang); enter a code here to override it, or -1 to follow the app language. Known codes: 0 = English, 11 = Indonesian, 15 = Vietnamese. Try a code, switch the ignition off and on, and watch the dash clock and default texts. Codes rejected by the CCU are logged as CCU: error. Return to -1 if the dash looks odd.
en: The dash asks the app for its language through the CCU. The code sent follows the language chosen in Settings > Appearance (see Translations.tsv, row @dashLang); enter a code here to override it, or -1 to follow the app language. Known codes: 0 = English, 11 = Indonesian, 15 = Vietnamese. Try a code, switch the ignition off and on, and watch the dash clock and default texts. Codes rejected by the CCU are logged as CCU: error. Return to -1 if the dash looks odd.
id: Dash menanyakan bahasa ke app lewat CCU. Kode yang dikirim mengikuti bahasa yang dipilih di Pengaturan > Tampilan (lihat baris @dashLang di Translations.tsv); isi kode di sini untuk menimpanya, atau -1 untuk mengikuti bahasa aplikasi. Kode yang dikenal: 0 = Inggris, 11 = Indonesia, 15 = Vietnam. Coba satu kode, matikan lalu nyalakan kontak, dan lihat jam dan teks bawaan dash. Kode yang ditolak CCU tercatat di Log sebagai CCU: error. Kembalikan ke -1 bila tampilan dash menjadi aneh.

key: Updates are fetched from GitHub Releases (the Actions workflow publishes them automatically on every build). iOS does not let an app install an IPA by itself, so the Install button opens SideStore, AltStore, or LiveContainer with the latest IPA: just one confirmation tap there. In LiveContainer, if the bundle ID already exists choose Replace so the app data stays. If XConnect itself runs inside LiveContainer, run it in multitasking mode or in a second LiveContainer so the main LiveContainer is free to process the installation.
en: Updates are fetched from GitHub Releases (the Actions workflow publishes them automatically on every build). iOS does not let an app install an IPA by itself, so the Install button opens SideStore, AltStore, or LiveContainer with the latest IPA: just one confirmation tap there. In LiveContainer, if the bundle ID already exists choose Replace so the app data stays. If XConnect itself runs inside LiveContainer, run it in multitasking mode or in a second LiveContainer so the main LiveContainer is free to process the installation.
id: Update diambil dari GitHub Releases (workflow Actions menerbitkannya otomatis setiap build). iOS tidak mengizinkan app memasang IPA sendiri, jadi tombol Pasang membuka SideStore, AltStore, atau LiveContainer dengan IPA terbaru: tinggal satu ketukan konfirmasi di sana. Di LiveContainer, bila bundle ID sudah ada pilih Ganti agar data app tetap. Bila XConnect sendiri dijalankan di dalam LiveContainer, jalankan dalam mode multitasking atau di LiveContainer kedua supaya LiveContainer utama bebas memproses pemasangan.

key: Zoom: the bigger the number, the closer the view. en: Zoom: the bigger the number, the closer the view. When auto zoom is on, zoom follows the GPS speed, whether navigating or not: the matching "below X km/h" rule is used, and speeds above all rules use the "above the last limit" zoom.
